name: Manistee River RV Resort & Marina
note: RV park and marina on the Manistee River at 20 Park Ave, Manistee, a short way upriver from Manistee Lake; back-in rustic and electric sites, with a row of electric waterfront sites along the river and marina. Booked online through CampLife. Back-in electric $48/night, electric waterfront $53-68, rustic $43. RV Life 4*/$$$ ~$42/night (auto 9/2026). --Claude
inclusion_evidence: manisteeriverrvresort.com / CampLife rates (read by AWH 2026-09-30; CampLife 403s to automated readers): back-in electric $48, electric waterfront $53-68, rustic $43 -> real transient RV campground; published base $48 (2026) <= $50; RV Life 4* over 10 reviews
